title: Local folder layer admission and ordering
summary: Try folder Extensions in id order after selected activation-profile layers. Keep only those that preserve admitted authority and pass Host check-only load; leave each refused layer off without losing earlier accepted layers.

replaceability.why: The adapter and layering machinery are the Host foundation. If this machinery could be replaced by a creator layer, automatic fallback to the original could not be guaranteed. The Lucs carried by open protocols have their own replacement classes.
replaceability.decided: Acrab, self-Luc spec v0.3, 2026-10-18; interface charter rule 6, 2026-10-22

reach.notes: Trusted Host machinery, not authority granted to a Luc. Package calls remain bounded by their resolved permissions, Host APIs and editable scope.

operations.name: layer_parent_reason
operations.notes: No deadline. Codes are returned refusal metadata. Parents with any reviewed permission take no folder layer, because its receipt names original bytes.

operations.name: lay_on

layers.description: Sequence[(Extension LucArtifact, metadata row with identity)].

output.description: Tuple(resolved ResolvedLuc or None when no new layer accepted, laid metadata rows, held refusal rows).

operations.notes: No deadline. Pure resolution and check-only Host validation, not live registration. Repeating same inputs is natural. Folder layers sort by id after under; duplicate source_hash already under is marked laid without reappending. One bad layer is reported and the next is tried on prior accepted state. Refusal metadata can preserve other E_LUC codes from Host/Resolver; exact union is not yet closed.

invariants.text: Folder layers cannot add authority beyond shipped original or already-authorized profile state.
A refused layer does not change the original, accepted predecessors or processing of later layers.
A reviewed Luc's original bytes cannot receive a folder layer.

A folder layer that would change what callers see of an Official Luc (its capabilities, their protocol, surface, names and schemas, a Panel's bridge events) or that its module's replaceability class does not allow is left off with an E_LUC_INTERFACE_* code, and the Luc loads without it.
Folder layer admission checks platform compatibility before Host API authority, and Host API authority before the interface gate.

break: The operation rejects invalid input, integrity, authority or binding state as described by its operation.

conformance.notes: Existing tests listed here were inspected, not run for this documentation task. The area checker validates the contract files; it does not exercise runtime behavior.

known_deviations.text: Folder order is sorted identity, while profile order is explicitly selected. Filenames choose package versions but do not choose layer application order.
